evidence.claim: Transaction 3523199 was flagged by a legacy risk score of 0.54, but the calibrated fraud model scored it at 0.005 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006.

Card C02923-K1 has 85 of 90 prior transactions in billing region 330, matching the flagged transaction, and has established history in online channel (21 transactions) and product category R (6 transactions).

Device D000178 is a generic iOS profile shared across 112 cards with no proxy and no ring association (ring_id -1), and 4 out of 5 historical cases on this device profile were cleared as false alarms (CC-0219, CC-0189, CC-0374, CC-0965).

Card window activity shows normal, steady spending with 10 in-person transactions and 1 online transaction, showing no card testing or velocity bursts, followed by legitimate in-person transaction 3532043 on 2016-12-10.
Historical confirmed fraud cases on card C02923-K1 (CC-2400, CC-2717, CC-2857) occurred in August 2016 under distinct holder IDs over three months before the alert, with no ongoing compromise.
Shared origin analysis shows no suspicious concentration: region 330 has a lift of 0.42 and recipient email domain gmail.com has low risk correlation.
Similar closed cases flagged by uncorroborated risk scores (CC-4591, CC-3521) were confirmed as legitimate cardholder activity and cleared.

case.summary: Transaction 3523199 ($100.07, online) on card C02923-K1 was flagged by an uncorroborated legacy risk score of 0.54. The calibrated fraud model evaluated the transaction at 0.005 with a historical fraud rate of only 0.006. The purchase aligns with the cardholder established profile, matching primary billing region 330 (85 of 90 prior transactions) and past online spending. Device D000178 is a generic iOS profile with no proxy or fraud ring associations, and surrounding account activity shows normal spending with no testing or disputes. The alert is determined to be a false alarm and cleared as legitimate.
